[RTIM.14.12] **The synthesized oracle rule is always built into the engine**,
unconditionally and on every compile of a test case ([RLOW.17.2]) — it is not
gated on any emission mode ([RCLI.2.1]). So the predicate of [RTIM.14.11] is load-bearing on
the test path with nothing extra required to carry it.

The synthesized oracle rules and the `Oracle*` atoms are test content, with the `Test*`
atoms ([RDSC.7.1]): test scaffolding, which a production runtime skips
([RDSC.9.4]) and does not need.
